items[].quantity_per_purchase.note: 1 = price_mesos buys one unit. MeowDB's Shop Item Efficiency guide divides one item's stat by the listed price (e.g. Red Potion: 100 HP / 50 mesos = "HP / meso" 2.000) and says "Arrows are 1 meso each". Re-checked on 22/22 guide rows for these shops; see cross_checks.shop_item_efficiency_guide.per_unit_ratio_rows.

items[].sell_price_mesos.note: item page "NPC Sell-back (per unit)" or "NPC Sell-back" row; when the page has no such row, the item API's stats.price (the page omits the row when the value is 0). sell_price_source says which one was used; fallback_pages lists the item API responses of the rows that took it.

items[].sell_price_basis.note: per_unit when the row label is "NPC Sell-back (per unit)", per_item when it is "NPC Sell-back". For rows taken from the item API (no label), per_unit if the item page has a "Max per Stack" row, else per_item; this rule reproduces the label on every labelled row (cross_checks.item_api.basis_rule_holds).

items[].sell_price_source.note: "item_page" or "item_api" (null if neither has a value)

items[].rechargeable.note: true only when the item page has a "Recharge Cost" row

items[].sell_price_history.note: Change history table, "Sell-back price" row (COT1 -> COT2)

discrepancies.reason: The item page is the item's own detail page; the shop list (the /npc-shops index and the NPC page render one dataset) spells it differently. The Shop Item Efficiency guide uses the item-page spelling. "name" uses the item-page name and the shop list spelling is kept in "shop_list_name". The item page says "Renamed in COT2. It was called Red-Striped Top."; the shop list shows that pre-COT2 name with different letter case.

The item page is the item's own detail page; the shop list (the /npc-shops index and the NPC page render one dataset) spells it differently. The Shop Item Efficiency guide uses the item-page spelling. "name" uses the item-page name and the shop list spelling is kept in "shop_list_name". MeowDB gives no rename note for this item.

gaps: MeowDB has no numeric shop id; "id" is the shop slug MeowDB uses as the /npc-shops anchor.
Purchase quantity: MeowDB prices one unit (quantity_per_purchase = 1) but documents no limit on how many units one purchase may buy.
stock_limit: MeowDB documents no stock limits (finite or restocking) for NPC shops.
Selling 0-mesos items: MeowDB records sell-back 0 for 13 item(s) here but does not say whether the NPC refuses them or pays 0 mesos.
Recharge: no item in this shop has a "Recharge Cost" row, and MeowDB does not say whether this NPC recharges throwing stars.
Sell rules: MeowDB documents per-item sell-back values only; it gives no general sell-price formula and no shop-specific sell restrictions.
notes: MeowDB price note for this shop: "Community screenshots 2026-08-12 (COT2) posted in Discord by SiuoL93; each list read top-to-bottom and found IDENTICAL to the first test - re-dated, not repriced."

price_mesos is the base price of ONE unit, in mesos. The citizenship discount (formulas/leveling, citizenship) applies only in Henesys or Kerning City, so it never applies to this shop; citizen_req is null on every row.

sell_price_mesos is 0 for 933 White Undershirt; 934 Grey T-Shirt; 935 Undershirt; 937 White Tube Top; 938 Yellow T-Shirt; 939 Green T-Shirt; 940 Red Striped Top; 1157 Blue Jean Shorts; 1158 Brown Cotton Shorts; 1160 Red Miniskirt; 1161 Indigo Miniskirt; 1305 Leather Sandals; 1306 Red Rubber Boots: the item API records stats.price 0 and the item page omits its "NPC Sell-back" row when the value is 0. Where the page does show the row, it equals the API value (7/7 rows across the Maple Island shops, and reference item 294 matching). Items MeowDB has no value for (the Safe-to-Sell "droppedNoPrice" items: 519 Glowing Mushroom, 2697 Luminous Magical Resonance, 2692 Rotten Root Fragment) have no price key at all, so 0 is a recorded value, not a gap.
Equipment item pages note: "NPC shop copies always roll clean." Equipment bought here has the item's clean (base) stats.
icon_key is MeowDB's icon key for the item. It is not the MeowDB item id; use item_id to join with items data.
